name: task-queue
description: A live pane with the session's task queue and progress, read from a per-session JSON file Claude keeps through bin/queue

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of what the pane writes for you and tells Claude: drafts in the prompt box, the compact text, the Stop hook's line, the owner words. Owner words in either language are read under both.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: plimsoll draws owners and model marks with the private-use glyphs of plimsoll's Statusline Icons font and a Nerd Font; plain uses ordinary Unicode any font draws.
